heading: What is OpenLake
content:
OpenLake is the open-source society of IIT Bhilai. It builds software the
campus actually uses, teaches students to make their first contribution, and
helps them contribute to open source elsewhere. Its tagline is
"Build. Learn. Contribute."

heading: Who can join OpenLake
content:
Anyone, from any batch or branch. Activities are public and free to join, and
no prior knowledge is needed to start.

heading: Do I need experience to join
content:
No. The workshops are aimed at people who have never opened a pull request,
and there are no prerequisites.

heading: Is there a fee to join
content:
No. There is no fee and no application. Join the Discord, come to a workshop,
or open an issue on any of the repositories.

heading: How do I join OpenLake
content:
There is no application process. Join the community Discord, attend a
workshop, or open an issue on any OpenLake repository.

heading: How do I make my first contribution
content:
Four steps: attend a workshop, pick a beginner-friendly issue in an OpenLake
repository and get a maintainer's review on your pull request, join a mentored
programme like FOSS Overflow or DevLabs, then contribute to outside programmes.

heading: What does OpenLake actually do
content:
Three stages, in order. Build: maintain campus software that has real users
and code review. Learn: free hands-on workshops on Git, Linux, web and app
development. Contribute: help members land contributions in the wider
open-source world.

heading: Why does OpenLake review pull requests
content:
Because a maintainer's review is the point of the beginner route. OpenLake
also says members should not stay confined to its own repositories, and that
the software should be real and used rather than practice exercises.

heading: How many projects does OpenLake have
content:
62 public repositories, 50 or more workshops and programmes run, and 9 GSoC
contributors whose proposals were accepted.

heading: How many people got into GSoC
content:
Nine contributors have had GSoC proposals accepted, five of them in 2023.
Members have also contributed to the Zowe Client Java SDK through an Open
Mainframe Project mentorship.

heading: What is FOSS Overflow
content:
FOSS Overflow is IIT Bhilai's annual open-source programme, a month-long
mentored hackathon. The January 2026 edition was described as India's largest
open-source hackathon.

heading: What is DevLabs
content:
DevLabs is a month-long mentored programme, listed alongside FOSS Overflow as
the step after your first reviewed pull request.

heading: What outside programmes does OpenLake point to
content: Google Summer of Code, LFX Mentorship, Outreachy and C4GT.

heading: Where can I see the code
content: All OpenLake projects are on GitHub at github.com/OpenLake.

heading: How do I contact OpenLake
content: Email openlake@iitbhilai.ac.in, or join the community Discord.

heading: Where is the OpenLake Discord
content:
The community Discord is at discord.gg/A2J9z92qzd. It is the main place to
ask questions and get started.

heading: Where is OpenLake on social media
content:
GitHub: github.com/OpenLake. Instagram: @openlake_iitbhilai. LinkedIn:
linkedin.com/company/openlake. X: @OpenLakeClub. YouTube: @openlakeiitbhilai1724.

heading: What campus tools does OpenLake build
content:
Student_Database_COSA manages student data and Positions of Responsibility.
Campus-Marketplace lets students buy and sell on campus. RateMyCourse collects
course and instructor reviews. Smart-Insti-App gathers institute information
and updates. RideShare handles ridesharing for students and staff.

heading: What tools are there for coursework
content:
iitbh-cgpa is a browser extension that calculates CGPA from the AIMS Portal.
iitbh-calendar generates a calendar for IIT Bhilai courses. Homework-Scheduler
helps teachers set deadlines around student commitments. Bhilaipedia is a wiki
for IIT Bhilai.

heading: What projects are there for electronics students
content:
bhilaee-labs is a virtual lab platform for Electrical and Electronics
Engineering experiments. bhilaee-simulator is a browser-based circuit
simulator with DC, AC and transient analysis. FOSSI covers free open-source
silicon, EDA tools and chip design.

heading: What projects involve machine learning
content:
SmartTriage finds duplicate issues by semantic search and auto-assigns
reviewers from commit history. Photo-Sharing-App groups photos by face.
Smart-Cams adds computer vision to CCTV and mobile cameras. AI-Voice-Agent is
a voice agent that adapts to its user. Speech-Analyser helps improve English
fluency.

heading: What projects help with placements and careers
content:
The Centre-for-Career-Planning-and-Services-Portal links students with the
placement cell. career-scraper analyses career trajectories. Knowledge holds
career-planning resources. Interview-Preparation and GSoC_Proposals archive
preparation material and past proposals.

heading: What is canonforces
content:
canonforces is a Codeforces companion with a built-in IDE, real-time 1v1 DSA
battles and stat syncing.

heading: What infrastructure does OpenLake run
content:
Hub connects OpenLake apps and provides unified APIs. auth-kit provides single
sign-on, JWT access control and role management across the ecosystem. Infra
holds the automation, bots and configuration that keep things running. Bit is
a git server built from scratch for IIT Bhilai.

heading: What fun projects are there
content:
Virtual-IIT-Bhilai is a virtual campus game world built with Godot and
Node.js. WatchParty allows remote movie watching with shared chat. Quiz-App
runs real-time quizzes and polls with live leaderboards. Live-Score-App does
real-time sports scoring. Find-your-Cluster finds shared interests among peers.

heading: What was the most recent event
content:
A Hacktoberfest Hack Day, Durg x OpenLake, held on 10 October 2026 in L101 at
IIT Bhilai. It was an official MLH Hack Day run with Major League Hacking and
DEV, with DigitalOcean, and included a morning workshop, an afternoon build
session with mentors, and evening demos and judging.

heading: What workshops has OpenLake run
content:
Recent ones include an intro session in August 2026, FOSS Overflow in January
2026, a Linux installation workshop in October 2025, a Git and GitHub workshop
in August 2025, and a GSoC introduction in January 2025.

heading: Where is OpenLake based
content:
OpenLake is the open-source society of IIT Bhilai, in Chhattisgarh. Workshops
and events are usually held on campus, often in L101.

heading: Can I get OpenLake stickers
content:
Yes. The site offers free stickers, open to programmers anywhere, not only
IIT Bhilai students.

heading: What is FOSS United
content:
FOSS United is described by OpenLake as India's largest open-source ecosystem.
OpenLake promotes it from its home page.

heading: What events are coming up
content:
OpenLake x Meraz 7.0 on 1 November 2026, at IIT Bhilai. Two events that day:
Agents War from 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM in L102, and the Gandhi Hackathon from
2:00 PM to 5:00 PM in L101. Both take registrations through forms linked on
the events page.

heading: What is Agents War
content:
A hands-on hackathon on 1 November 2026, 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM in L102, run as
part of OpenLake x Meraz 7.0. Participants build autonomous AI agents and test
them against simulated challenges, with prizes for the most capable agents.
Register through the form linked on the events page.

heading: What is the Gandhi Hackathon
content:
A creative coding hackathon on 1 November 2026, 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM in L101,
part of OpenLake x Meraz 7.0. The theme is technology for social impact, with
prizes for the highest-impact projects. Register through the form linked on
the events page.

heading: How do I register for the Meraz events
content:
Both Agents War and the Gandhi Hackathon take registrations through Google
Forms linked next to each event on the events page at openlake.in/newevents.

heading: When did OpenLake start
content:
OpenLake has been building since 2020. Its workshop programme has run since
June 2022.

heading: What are the most popular OpenLake projects
content:
By GitHub stars as of October 2026: Sampoorna (35), iitbh-calendar (31),
Leaderboard-Pro (30), iitbh-cgpa (28), Photo-Sharing-App (26), WatchParty (23),
Activity-Tracker (23), PixOss (21) and Knowledge-Sharing-Platform (20).

heading: What programming languages does OpenLake use
content:
Across the 62 repositories: JavaScript and TypeScript most often, then Dart
for the Flutter mobile apps, Python for the machine-learning and tooling
projects, and C++ for Bit and the Linux memory-imaging work. Also Kotlin
(Sampoorna), PHP (Bhilaipedia), Svelte (iitbh-calendar), GDScript (SDAC
Venture) and Jupyter Notebook (Speech-Analyser).

heading: What is Sampoorna
content:
Sampoorna is an app for women covering safety, health and more. It is written
in Kotlin and is OpenLake's most-starred repository.

heading: What is iitbh-calendar
content:
iitbh-calendar generates a calendar of IIT Bhilai courses. It is written in
Svelte.

heading: What is Leaderboard-Pro
content:
Leaderboard-Pro is a leaderboard that scrapes competitive-programming
platforms and aggregates the rankings. It is written in JavaScript. A related
repository, leaderboardpro, is in Python.

heading: What is iitbh-cgpa
content:
iitbh-cgpa is a browser extension that calculates CGPA from the AIMS portal.
It is written in JavaScript.

heading: What is the Photo-Sharing-App
content:
A group photo-sharing app that arranges uploads by the faces in them, using
machine learning.

heading: What is WatchParty
content:
WatchParty lets people watch films together remotely with a shared group chat.
It is written in JavaScript.

heading: What is Activity-Tracker
content:
A cross-platform tool that shows how you spend your digital time. Written in
JavaScript.

heading: What is PixOss
content:
PixOss is a deployment of a community canvas, where many people draw on one
shared grid. Written in TypeScript.

heading: What is the Knowledge-Sharing-Platform
content:
A platform for sharing study notes and reviews of professors and courses.
Written in TypeScript.

heading: What is Student_Database_COSA
content:
A platform for student data and Positions of Responsibility, used by the
Council of Student Affairs. Written in JavaScript.

heading: What is RateMyCourse
content:
RateMyCourse collects community ratings and reviews of IIT Bhilai courses and
instructors. Written in TypeScript.

heading: What is the Campus-Marketplace
content:
A marketplace for students to buy, sell and exchange items on campus. Written
in JavaScript.

heading: What is Not-a-Mess
content:
Not-a-Mess is an app for raising and resolving mess-related issues. Written in
Dart.

heading: What is Insti-Pay
content:
Payment infrastructure for transactions inside IIT Bhilai, intended to work
across institutes. Written in Dart.

heading: What is the Smart-Insti-App
content: An app for institute information and updates. Written in Dart.

heading: What is the File-Sharing-App
content: Peer-to-peer file sharing between devices. Written in Dart.

heading: What is Find-your-Cluster
content:
Finds common interests among peers so people can build a community around
them. Written in Dart.

heading: What is the Live-Score-App
content: Real-time scores for sports and tournaments. Written in Dart.

heading: What is the Quiz-App
content: A real-time quizzing, polling and survey platform. Written in Dart.

heading: What is Bit
content:
Bit is a git implementation and git server built from scratch for IIT Bhilai,
written in C++.

heading: What is the Online-Judge
content:
An online judge for programming competitions and assignments. Written in
Python.

heading: What is SmartTriage
content:
A machine-learning bot that flags duplicate issues using semantic search and
assigns reviewers.

heading: What is Smart-Cams
content: Computer vision for CCTV and mobile cameras. Written in Python.

heading: What is the AI-Voice-Agent
content: An adaptive, personalised AI voice agent. Written in Python.

heading: What is the Speech-Analyser
content: An app to help improve English fluency. Built in Jupyter Notebook.

heading: What is RideShare
content:
A ridesharing platform for IIT Bhilai students and staff, covering trips
between campus, Raipur and nearby cities, aimed at making travel cheaper and
safer.

heading: What is Virtual-IIT-Bhilai
content: A virtual campus game world for IIT Bhilai, built with Godot and Node.js.

heading: What is SDAC Venture
content:
A first-person shooter game set on the IIT Bhilai campus, built with the Godot
engine in GDScript.

heading: What is Bhilaipedia
content: A collaborative wiki for IIT Bhilai, built on MediaWiki and MySQL in PHP.

heading: What is Remote-Voting-Blockchain
content: An electronic voting system implemented on Hyperledger Fabric.

heading: What is Memory-Imaging-for-Linux-Family
content:
Tools for Linux binary analysis and for making changes to binaries on the fly.
Written in C++.

heading: What is the Active-OSS-Community-Finder
content:
A tool for discovering open-source projects where you can become a regular
contributor. Written in Python.

heading: What is Interview-Preparation
content: A repository of interview preparation material. Written in TypeScript.

heading: What is the career-scraper
content: Scrapes data to show what career trajectories different people have taken.

heading: What is the Homework-Scheduler
content:
Helps teachers set homework deadlines around students' other commitments.
Written in JavaScript.

heading: What is bhilaee-labs
content:
A virtual lab platform for Electrical and Electronics Engineering students.
Written in JavaScript.

heading: What is the bhilaee-simulator
content: A browser-based circuit simulator. Written in JavaScript.

heading: What is Hub
content:
Hub is the integration and sync layer for the OpenLake ecosystem, written in
TypeScript.

heading: What is auth-kit
content:
auth-kit provides centralised authentication and single sign-on across the
OpenLake ecosystem.

heading: What is Infra
content:
Infra holds the automation tools, bots, scripts and configuration that keep
OpenLake running. Written in JavaScript.

heading: What is FOSSI
content:
FOSSI is a learning group for open-source silicon, covering EDA tools and
chip-design projects.

heading: Does OpenLake have a blog
content:
Yes. The blog has its own repository at github.com/OpenLake/blog, written in
JavaScript.

heading: What is the Sci-Tech Council website
content:
OpenLake maintains the website of the Sci-Tech Council of IIT Bhilai, written
in JavaScript.

heading: What is studious-learners
content: A repository of study material for events OpenLake has run.

heading: What is GSoC_Proposals
content:
An archive of Google Summer of Code and other open-source programme proposals
written by IIT Bhilai students.

heading: What is DevLabs 2025
content:
The repository for the 2025 edition of DevLabs, OpenLake's month-long mentored
programme.

heading: Where are the OpenLake branding assets
content:
All branding assets for OpenLake and FOSS Overflow are in the Branding
repository on GitHub.

heading: What is Hacktoberfest at OpenLake
content:
OpenLake ran an official MLH Hacktoberfest Hack Day with Durg on 10 October
2026 in L101, together with Major League Hacking and DEV and with DigitalOcean,
focused on AI projects and open-source contributions.

heading: What beginner workshops has OpenLake run
content:
A Linux installation workshop in October 2025, a Git and GitHub workshop for
beginners in August 2025, Intro to Software Development in January 2025, A
Quick Start to Software Development in October 2024, How to Open-Source in
June 2023, OpenlySourced with Anand Panchbai in August 2022, Object Oriented
Programming and Flask in August 2022, and an HTML and CSS tutorial with a mini
hackathon in June 2022.

heading: Who has spoken at an OpenLake event
content:
The events page names Anand Panchbai, who ran the OpenlySourced introductory
open-source workshop in August 2022. Other events are listed without a speaker.

heading: Has OpenLake run introductory programming courses
content:
Yes. Introduction_CPP and Introduction_Python were introductory open-source
events, both marked completed.
